record_type.description: Preparation lock, not a benchmark result or eligibility certificate.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier; independent of provider and model spelling.

benchmark_commit.description: Exact benchmark Git HEAD at preparation; null outside Git.

benchmark_dirty.description: Observed source worktree state; scored locks require false.

opencode_version.description: Exact expected OpenCode release supplied by the owner; no automatic update or latest alias.

observed_opencode_version.description: Owner-reported actual release from a safe runtime observation; null until supplied.

opencode_artifact_sha256.description: Owner-supplied checksum of the pinned OpenCode executable/distribution; null if unrecorded.

python_version.description: Python version actually observed by this offline preparation process.

pytest_version.description: Installed pytest distribution version; null when unavailable.

git_version.description: Observed system Git version using sanitized Git execution.

operating_system.description: Observed preparation operating system and release; execution provenance must match its runtime.

runtime_image.description: Immutable execution image reference/digest where applicable; null before selection or for native preparation.

provider.description: Fixed project provider ID, preserved in every workspace.

model_id.description: Exact preferred catalog provider model ID; floating and alternative alias candidates are forbidden.

provider_config_path.description: Selected secret-free config path relative to the repository.

provider_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact selected configuration bytes.

provider_evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact provider metadata bytes; it hashes the evidence card, not remotely linked documents.

catalog_snapshot_sha256.description: Exact sanitized catalog hash when supplied; null if no archived catalog is available.

fixture_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact immutable fixture manifest bytes.

prompt_set_version.description: Version of the unchanged provider-independent prompt set.

prompt_id.description: Task prompt identifier from the frozen prompt manifest.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact delivered UTF-8 task prompt bytes.

prompt_metadata_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact prompt metadata file, including provenance.

requirements_sha256.description: SHA-256 of validation dependency pins; not a complete runtime image identity.

requirements_resolved_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the dependency resolution lock for CI Python; other runtimes need their own lock.

preparation_environment_only.description: This offline utility observes preparation, never starts OpenCode; execution must attest runtime equality.

protocol_track.description: Restricted and agentic are distinct estimands; agentic remains design-only.

sandbox_review_id.description: Human-approved implementation audit identifier; null while runtime isolation is unimplemented.
